CustomObject.label: BotShield Census
CustomObject.description: One row per BotShield Census verification (the "is a human here?" rail). Written by the BotShield Console push (upsert on Request_ID__c) and read in-org by the checkout gate; CDC-enabled so Flows/LWCs react the moment a verification lands. Mirrors the Console Verification Logs — outcome only, never PII.
